statement: For iid N(0,1) vertex weights g_v on Z^2, let P_n be every up/right path of n visited vertices, starting at (0,0), including the origin, with free endpoint. Set M_n=max_{p in P_n} sum_{v in p} g_v. Improve the source's Var(M_n)<=C n/log n estimate to a power variance bound: find epsilon>0 and C'<infinity, independent of n, such that Var(M_n)<=C' n^(1-epsilon) for n>=2. The source asks to improve the fluctuation exponent; the inequality is the campaign's concrete formulation of that question.
status_search: Source-scope correction proposed 2026-10-10 by w498; current openness UNKNOWN. arXiv:0810.4221v2 Sections 1 and 8 concern a planar Gaussian ground-state maximum, not finite-temperature log Z_n or general disorder/dimension. Those broader extensions require separate sources. No solved/retired claim.
title: Fluctuation exponent of directed polymers beyond the logarithmic improvement
